changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: A generic sample remains pending while any core collection value is missing. This corrects historical records that contain only a partial value, such as quantity without its unit, collection timestamp, or collector.

update.where: data_completion_status = 'COMPLETED' AND (quantity IS NULL OR uom_id IS NULL OR collection_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(BTRIM(collector), '') = '')
